SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Ask the fishery which lake fits a beginner, the preferred target and the available hire equipment. Select the session first; a managed coarse-fishing visit does not automatically need mountain-walking equipment or a coastal sea-fishing rod.

Choose the access before the outfit

Lake fishing can mean a bank session, trolling, jigging or a guided casting day. Confirm which of those is actually offered. Check boat and equipment provision before buying a second setup, and keep the personal day bag distinct from shared tackle.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for England & Wales

Anglers aged 13 and above need a rod licence for salmon, trout, freshwater fish, smelt or eel. They also need the land or fishery owner's permission, including on private fishing lakes.

  • 1 dayGBP 7.30
  • 8 daysGBP 14.70

Rules for this water

  • On Catfish Lake, use single barbless hooks and a running rig.
  • Each Catfish Lake angler needs a separate landing net at least 50 inches wide.
